title: Instance Counter
instructions:
Complete the `Subsystem` class so that the companion object tracks how many instances have been created.

The companion object should have a `var count: Int` that starts at `0`. Every time a new `Subsystem` is created, `count` should increase by 1.

Use an `init` block to increase the count when a new instance is created.
hint: Add `var count = 0` inside the companion object. Add an `init { count++ }` block inside the class (but outside the companion object). The init block runs every time an instance is created.
